entities.title: No relevance ranking and no dependency graph
entities.summary: find_symbol puts exact matches first and then orders by path; there is no relevance ranking and no import or dependency graph.
entities.impact: With many matches, the most useful ones may be on a later page.

entities.title: view has no size cap and no paging
entities.summary: ViewTool reads the whole .cs file and returns the whole view; it has no file-size limit and no paging. zazzle read shows only the asked range under its budget, but the indexer still builds the view of the whole file.
entities.impact: A very large or generated C# file is parsed with Roslyn and sent over the socket in full on every read, however little of it is shown.
entities.workaround: zazzle read --source with a line range reads the code without asking for the view.
